_why_this_exists: ⚠️ THE FULL A-Z HARVEST HAS A BLIND SPOT AND THIS IS IT. Pages 1-15 (the A through G surnames) were swept on 2026-08-03/04. Every referee who registered AFTER that date with an early-alphabet surname was inserted into the directory BEHIND the sweep and was never captured. CA's total grew 3,278 -> 3,549 across the harvest - 271 people - and this is where a chunk of them hid. Of the first 22 CA IDs checked off this page, SIXTEEN were not in our roster. All are 41xxx IDs, i.e. registered in the last few weeks.
_going_forward: Tod, 2026-09-08: 'Going forward, I'll be probably sweeping these once a week.' and 'If there are any new ones, we add them, if not, we leave them.' The NEW REFEREE filter is the right instrument: it surfaces recent signups regardless of surname, so it does not care where the alphabetical sweep happens to be. Weekly is more than enough - CA added roughly 271 in five weeks.
_headline: 16 of the first 22 checked were NOT in our roster - the A-G blind spot is real. Also resolves Owen Baillargeon #41010, flagged as an ambiguous email since page 4 of the harvest: it is obaillargeon@acconnecticut.com, a company domain, not the gmail we guessed.
